prerequisites: Knowledge of the appurtenances of component drawings and assembly units.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability of creative thinking within the individually assigned machine design task with the possibility to apply his / her original solution to the problem.

Ability to use design methodology in designing a machine unit, including task assignment, information collection, variant design, optimal design, component and assembly drawing, list of items and with technical report.
Knowledge of CAD support in the field of computational tools for the design dimensions of standard machine components.
Students will be able to design a simple system design that meets the basic design requirements according to the assignment.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of design methodology, algorithm for solving a design task.
Introduction to the add-on module for Autodesk Inventor – Design accelerator. Dimensioning of parts, dimensional and control calculations.
Creation of technical documentation, use of design and production documentation. Economic analysis of solutions.
Principles of presentation of work results, creation of accompanying technical documentation of the solution.
Regular consultations on the progress of the solution and continuous control of the students' work.

assessment_methods.method: Satisfactory elaborated solution of the design problem

assessment_rules: The student has to submit a satisfactory elaborated solution of the design problem. Final classification is according to ECTS. Attendance at seminars is required and controlled, with a maximum of two authorized absences tolerated without compensation.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
